task.title: Materialize Pantheon OpenClaw gateway adapter boundary
task.summary_zh: 把 OpenClaw 從 compose optional gateway image 補成 Pantheon-owned adapter boundary：提供受控 health/capability/session metadata facade 與 degraded semantics，但不打開 broker/live execution。
acceptance: Adds a Pantheon-owned openclaw-gateway-adapter service boundary or records a code-backed explicit deferral if implementation is blocked
Adapter exposes /healthz /livez /readyz and capability or session metadata routes
Adapter degrades cleanly when optional OpenClaw gateway is absent or unhealthy
No live broker execution paper or production adapter path is enabled
Compose and smoke tests cover the optional profile or clearly documented defer disposition
task.next: Owner finalized approved OpenClaw gateway adapter boundary. Accepted reviewer documentation consistency fix; adapter boundary, default compose wiring, degraded semantics, session deferral, review packet, and verification evidence are closed under commit 7300648.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：openclaw-gateway-adapter 已落成 Pantheon-owned default boundary，health/capability/session deferral routes 與 upstream absence degraded semantics 符合 task acceptance。
未發現阻擋項；reviewer 已補 gap inventory default profile 清單，讓文件列出 openclaw-gateway-adapter。驗證包含 adapter tests、compose config/profile config、py_compile、diff check 與 docker compose build。

handoffs.message: Implemented Pantheon openclaw-gateway-adapter boundary: facade health/capability/session deferral routes, default compose service with /livez healthcheck, smoke degraded-path coverage, docs disposition. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/test_main.py services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/test_compose_activation.py -q; python3 -m pytest services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_compose_activation.py -q; docker compose config --quiet; python3 -m py_compile scripts/smoke_honest_stack.py services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/main.py; docker compose build openclaw-gateway-adapter.
Review approved. OpenClaw gateway adapter boundary matches acceptance; owner can finalize to done after accepting reviewer doc consistency fix.
